scope: Diagnostic native junction API tracing for the historical same-byte Windows runtime; not current-source packaging acceptance

installedRuntime.validation: The host probe verifies identical repository and installed bytes before starting any case; the repository path retains those bytes.

checks.detail: Direct Python and repository runtime create/read the junction. Installed runtime opens the private directory but FSCTL_SET_REPARSE_POINT returns ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED (5). The handle closes. The wrapper also exceeded its 20-second observation deadline and taskkill returned 128; these are retained independently from the native error and final exit 1.

conclusions.note: The result localizes the existing pnpm/Node EPERM below Node and Python to the native reparse-point operation. It does not identify a particular ACL, token field, security product, compatibility layer, or driver as the cause.

exclusions: No changes to ACL, token privileges, Developer Mode, antivirus, compatibility settings, registry, or package-manager configuration
Generated private link directories only; historical runtime bytes preserved; no user profile or product data migration
